status: PREREGISTERED BEFORE NEW DATA OR OUTCOMES
question: Does replacing total by rest score change operational latent-null Holm-FWER for the same ordinal-LR procedure? No assumption that rest score fixes the latent/observed conditioning mismatch.
methods: production ordinal LR omnibus, total score
same production ordinal LR omnibus, rest score excluding studied item
dgp: Existing gen_ordinal, N500/500 J10 C4 a=linspace(.9,1.8), b=linspace(-1,1)+[-1,0,1], theta N(0,1) in BOTH groups, no latent DIF, local independence
matching: Total uses all ten items including target; rest uses the other nine. No purification or selected anchors; exact same raw matrix and row order for both methods.
multiplicity: Holm across the same two items primary; BH descriptive secondary
primary: Impact0 total-minus-rest paired dataset-level Holm-FWER event difference
estimand_note: False-DIF operating risk relative to latent invariance, not the same formal conditional null for the two matching variables
n_derivation: D in [-1,1] implies Var(D)<=1, so true MCSE(mean D)<=1/sqrt(R). R=ceil(1/.02^2)=2500. This is not a .02 confidence-halfwidth target.
primary_ci: Fixed-R marginal two-sided distribution-free Hoeffding: mean D +/- sqrt(2 log(2/.05)/R), clipped to [-1,1]
secondary_fwer_intervals: Per-method exact CP at 97.5% (Bonferroni joint >=95% for two methods). These do not guarantee the older PR118 .02 interval-deviation target.
acceptance: No new numerical thresholds. Primary directional result requires fixed2500 all-valid pairs and marginal95% Hoeffding excludes0. Simultaneous cross-contrast statements require their Bonferroni Hoeffding intervals exclude0. Per-method scoped inflation lowerCP>.05, control upperCP<=.05, else inconclusive. Near .05 is descriptive, not equivalence certification. McNemar never certifies FWER control.
failures: Any incomplete two-item family/convergence failure invalidates its method. Retain failed/partial results and matrices, no retries/replacement. Complete-case contrasts explicitly conditional; show unknown-failure bounds ([-1,1] per missing binary difference, [-2,2] for interaction). Confirmatory conclusions require2500 valid zero pairs and corresponding valid cached negative outcomes; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. RNG/hash mismatch stops immediately as BLOCKED.
seed_rule: 2026110100 + index, same order as PR120; verify actual shared RNG draws and archived data hashes before fitting each new dataset
timing_rule: First30 validity and runtime only, no event-based selection; included in2500 iff unchanged design. Continue only30/30 valid and elapsed/30*2500<=1800 seconds. 1800-second wall fitting deadline; incomplete experiment diagnostic, no relaxed thresholds.
timing_limitation: Rest timing not yet measured; estimate is not guaranteed; 30-pair feasibility stage required. No optional stopping for significant/favorable results. Budget/validity stop => no confirmatory acceptance.
scope_limits: Only this DGP/impact/test length/family/no-selection setting; no power, anchor-selection or general FDR claims
discordance_definition: b=total Holm event only; c=rest Holm event only; a=both; d=neither. Delta=(b-c)/valid complete pairs.
mcnemar: Exact two-sided conditional binomial test b | (b+c) ~ Binomial(b+c,0.5); b+c=0 => p=1 with no-discordance warning; zero valid pairs => undefined. This tests equal marginal event probabilities, not nominal FWER control.
paired_exact_ci: For a binary event contrast, pi=discordance probability and q=positive-only conditional probability; two97.5% CP intervals give joint>=95%, then extrema of pi*(2q-1). Interaction uses component97.5% intervals (each built from98.75% CP intervals).
primary_rule: Original primary Hoeffding interval and fixed-R validity/precision rules retained. Exact paired CI and McNemar are supplementary sensitivity/inference, never selected post hoc to override a primary inconclusive result or certify FWER.
method_ci: Individual method FWER with 97.5% exact CP, joint >=95% for two methods; separate unknown-failure bounds. No equality/nominal control inferred from McNemar.
feasibility_decision: Run exactly first30 pairs, inspect validity and runtime only; do not use event counts or effect direction to select expansion. Continue only if 30/30 pairs valid and elapsed/30*2500 <=1800s. No retries or seed replacement. Main may retain later failed pairs; no confirmatory acceptance unless fixed2500 complete valid pairs.
budget_deadline: 1800s fitting wall deadline; interrupted attempted pair recorded invalid with partial diagnostics. Reset timer after execution. Budget/feasibility stops remain diagnostic, not confirmatory.
data_storage: Every zero repeat raw LR/p/decisions/seed/hash/time; first30 and any failed matrices compressed. All-repeat CRN trace hashes plus archived response-hash checks. Reuse immutable cached negative results. No old refit or stored evidence modification.
missing_pairs: Never impute failed analysis as no event. Conditional complete-pair estimates, b/c, missing-pair empirical sensitivity, per-method failures and conservative failure envelopes; incomplete experiment => INCONCLUSIVE.
paired_mcse_formula: sqrt((sum(D^2)-sum(D)^2/n)/(n-1)/n), D in {-1,0,1}; n<2 undefined. Report zero empirical MCSE with nonzero interval uncertainty.
stopping_after_main_failure: Retain failures without retry; continue while within budget to estimate failure rate. Confirmatory acceptance remains disabled if any invalid pair.
no_other_engines: Only production total/rest ordinal LR. No R, GRM-LR, 4PL or full regression.
secondary: Within each method: impact0-minus-impact_minus0.5 paired Holm event difference; interaction=(total-rest)_0-(total-rest)_minus0.5
crn: Trace the actual zero-impact generator normal and uniform calls. Reconstruct negative-impact responses from these SAME draws, without any old fits; require exact archived data-content hash for every seed, exact reference rows, common unshifted latent normals, identical item uniform arrays and monotone focal responses. Stop on any mismatch; seed equality alone is insufficient.
multiplicity_scope: Primary marginal95% Hoeffding rule unchanged. Also report Bonferroni95% simultaneous Hoeffding intervals across FOUR contrasts: zero within-method comparison, total impact change, rest impact change, interaction (alpha=.05/4 each). McNemar exists for THREE binary event contrasts only; report raw and Holm-adjusted p across those3. Separate per-method97.5% CP intervals have joint>=95% within each condition only, NOT across both conditions and all other intervals. Marginal exact paired95% intervals are NOT joint95% across contrasts.
interaction: Paired quadruples on verified common draws; W=(T0-R0)-(Tm-Rm) in [-2,2]. Mean and sampleSD/sqrt(n) MCSE. Marginal95% Hoeffding halfwidth sqrt(8 log(40)/n). Supplementary paired95% conservative exact interval via the difference of TWO97.5% exact paired risk-difference intervals, union bound. No McNemar for nonbinary W; report 3x3 signed-event table and full16-cell binary quadruple table.
causal_scope: Only DGP-controlled focal latent mean is changed; CRN is a computational coupling, not independent empirical human-treatment evidence. Interaction need not imply a production algorithm error. No broad certification, no production label/gate change.
